reviewer: Independent assistant semantic review of all 60 actual development outputs; no heldout inspected or prompt tuning performed. Synthetic agent-authored fixtures, not user-approved conversational gold.
scope: native raw complete responses before Core validation/fallback; baseline is actual Core dictionary/number-normalized text

definitions.faithful: Retains intended facts, uncertainty, tone, verbatim quotations/literals and dictated-text nature; explicit corrections may remove superseded facts.
definitions.edit_needed: Human judgment that Core-normalized baseline needs cleanup; excludes benign alternative wording and already normalized numbers.
definitions.useful: Faithful output makes a beneficial edit to an input needing cleanup; partial correction may count, so use cleanup_complete separately.
definitions.cleanup_complete: Meets intended cleanup at adequate fidelity; preserves no-edit text acceptably. Minor punctuation alternatives do not fail this judgment.
